description: Java class 'AndroidInheritingClassBrowser' extending 'AndroidClassBrowserBase' for browsing classes inheriting from a specified base class within Android development tools.

classes.name: AndroidInheritingClassBrowser
classes.description: A class for browsing and selecting classes that inherit from a specified base class within an Android project, providing a UI dialog for class selection.

methods.name: AndroidInheritingClassBrowser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the browser with project context, module selector, base class name, dialog title, and library inclusion flag.

methods.name: createTreeClassChooser
methods.description: Creates a class chooser dialog filtered to show classes inheriting from the specified base class, handling errors if the base class is not found.
